- Email 1 "Votre archive reste hors du périmètre": Avec orqAgent, l’équipe peut faire préparer des réponses sans déléguer l’envoi : l’auto-réponse est désactivée par défaut et chaque brouillon attend une validation humaine. - pull 6/10 - still below the 7/10 floor, and rewriting had stopped moving it after 1 rewrite(s)
- Email 2 "Avant de présenter orqAgent en interne": Le lecteur peut juger orqAgent sur ses propres documents avant toute mise en production : importer une FAQ ou une politique, puis poser quelques vraies questions dans le Playground. - pull 6/10 - still below the 7/10 floor, and rewriting had stopped moving it after 3 rewrite(s) - and argues from none of the evidence it was assigned

Sequence: La séquence tient sa promesse et progresse clairement de la maîtrise humaine des envois vers un test concret, autonome et sans intégration préalable.
Email(s) 2 made no use of the evidence they were built on. Nothing in them is invented - but nothing in them is checkable either, and a stranger has no reason to believe a company describing itself.
What held the copy back: No customer names, quotes or case studies found - the copy can describe the product but cannot prove anyone uses it
What would help most next time: Resolve this simulated next-step obstacle: I would have clicked if this email had told me I could test one FAQ document on sample tickets, without connecting the live inbox, and shown exactly how unsupported policy claims are flagged. Check existing verified material first; surface a supported answer or documentation link appropriate to the CTA. If absent, obtain this specific information. Reader expectations are not product evidence.
